After two-point calibration, a polyline `measurement` equals pixel length divided by `pixelsPerFoot`.
`polygonAreaSF` returns shoelace area in SF; `sfToCY(area, depth)` = `area * depth / 27`; `sfToSY(area)` = `area / 9`.
`pointInPolygon` correctly classifies inside/outside via ray-casting.
With 2 GPS control points, `solveAffine2` round-trips each control point's `plan` coordinate to floating-point precision.
With 3+ control points, `solveAffine3` returns least-squares affine; `estimateError` returns non-zero residual when points are non-collinear
Kalman: `updateKalman` with a high-accuracy measurement pulls state toward new reading; zero-dt update returns position unchanged.
Dragging a polygon vertex updates only that vertex; measurement recalculates live.
